properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Document Intelligence: No Public Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Document Intelligence (Form Recognizer) accounts with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Document Intelligence processing federal documents containing PII must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public network access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized document exposure.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Document Intelligence with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
